comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, a low-wage return (wages 4,000, one child, W-2 box 10 benefits 5,000, care expenses 5,000) with W-2 box 12 code Q 8,000 and all three elections answered none. The combat pay reaches Schedule 8812 line 18b on its own: the additional child tax credit rises 375 → 1,575 (line 33 2,084 → 3,284); the earned income credit (1,709) and the benefits exclusion (4,000, capped by earned income) are figured without it.
